name: full attached reattach marker
why: Three final-source full runs failed with waiting-for-frame at ATTACHED_REATTACH_MARKER. The unchanged rebased binary passes a later full run after the delta workload ends. Two clean pre-lane full runs, the full reverted-fix build, both single-change variants, --lifecycle and the bounded late-probe subset pass. No causal source change is established and no frame-delivery fix is claimed.

name: control return-status matrix
why: The full package and serial control family fail at different marker waits. The clean baseline also fails this test at a different marker; this establishes an existing family problem without equating every timeout.

name: control wait-exit unbounded process wait
why: The candidate package child and clean-baseline serial child each remained in wait_with_output for more than three minutes and were terminated by this lane. Candidate solo/serial retries pass. These interrupted tests are not counted as natural timeouts or passes.

name: refresh-client notifications and menu sizing
why: Notification and menu-sizing cases fail in the candidate serial control family but pass in the clean baseline and in the candidate refresh_client_ filter (3 passes). The earlier failures remain retained.

name: background inserted control flags
why: The full candidate package run fails this case; the candidate serial control family and focused retry pass.

name: slow-client agent soak item count
why: Candidate full and solo runs produce 1501 items against 1500 expected. A clean, independently built c550a396 baseline reproduces the same count.
